I have found a formula for calculating magazine sizes assuming Triple Tap (TT) and Fourth Time's the Charm (FTTC). / Where m is the current magazine: / TT(m) = Floor(m/3) + Mod(m, 3) + m / FTTC(m) = Floor(m/4) * 4 + m / / You know, I might actually make a dedicated math section for perks and their respective increases
